biomarkers.name: MyoD1, myogenin
biomarkers.prevalence: Usually positive; myogenin is typically patchy/focal in ERMS
biomarkers.clinical_use: Patchy myogenin pattern favours ERMS over ARMS

biomarkers.name: RAS pathway alterations (NRAS, KRAS, HRAS, NF1, FGFR4)
biomarkers.prevalence: Common; pathway alterations in a substantial subset of fusion-negative/embryonal RMS
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common drivers; potential pathway-directed clinical trial relevance

biomarkers.name: MYOD1 L122R (spindle cell / sclerosing RMS)
biomarkers.prevalence: Enriched in spindle cell / sclerosing RMS; uncommon in typical ERMS

biomarkers.name: DICER1 (germline; embryonal RMS, especially genitourinary site)
FOXO1 fusion status (negative)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Helps distinguish ERMS from fusion-positive ARMS

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Primitive spindle to round cells with rhabdomyoblastic differentiation; heterogeneous cellularity with hypercellular and hypocellular zones
variants: botryoid (grape-like clusters in hollow organs — vagina, bladder, bile duct — best prognosis)
spindle cell / sclerosing RMS (MYOD1 L122R subset, adverse)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Better prognosis than ARMS overall; specific variants have distinct behaviour

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Loose myxoid stroma alternating with cellular areas; botryoid variant has cambium layer

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Primitive mesenchymal cells with skeletal muscle differentiation potential
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Primitive spindle to round cells with rhabdomyoblastic differentiation (MyoD1+, myogenin more heterogeneous than ARMS, desmin+); heterogeneous cellularity
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: No recurrent lineage-defining fusion; 11p15 loss of heterozygosity/imprinting abnormalities are common; RAS pathway alterations are frequent; DICER1 germline predisposes to a subset of embryonal RMS
